files.title: API Rate Limits and Delivery Rules

knowledge_profile.role_scope: Platform Operations and Customer Operations handover

findings.title: Outage start time
findings.summary: The customer-facing outage began at 09:12 IST.
findings.source_quote: The customer-facing outage began at 09:12 IST and service was restored at 09:50 IST.

findings.title: Incident trigger
findings.summary: Connection-pool exhaustion occurred during a downstream timeout spike.
findings.source_quote: The 14 March 2026 event was triggered by a connection-pool exhaustion condition during a downstream timeout spike.

findings.title: Access-token lifetime
findings.source_quote: Access tokens have a 15 minute lifetime.

findings.title: Role-claim refresh
findings.summary: A role change applies after session claims are refreshed.
findings.source_quote: A role change takes effect on the next authenticated request after session claims are refreshed.

findings.title: Confidential source access
findings.summary: Confidential source files are restricted to the employee and authorised managers.
findings.source_quote: Confidential source files are available only to the Employee and authorised Manager roles.

findings.title: Default API limit
findings.summary: The default public API limit is 50 requests per second per client key.
findings.source_quote: requests per second per client key

findings.title: Rate-limit response
findings.summary: Rate-limited requests return HTTP 429 and a Retry-After header.

findings.title: Webhook retry policy
findings.summary: Outbound webhook delivery is retried three times using exponential backoff.

findings.title: Frontline refund authority
findings.summary: Frontline agents may approve eligible goodwill refunds up to INR 5,00,000.
findings.source_quote: A frontline agent may approve a goodwill refund up to INR 5,00,000 only when the documented eligibility checks pass.

findings.title: Refund escalation threshold
findings.summary: Refunds above INR 5,00,000 require Finance Director approval.
findings.source_quote: Refunds above INR 5,00,000 require Finance Director approval.

findings.title: Refund communication guardrail
findings.summary: Support must check payment records and the case timeline before promising a refund.
findings.source_quote: Do not promise a refund until the payment record and case timeline have been checked.

findings.title: Severity 1 deployment freeze
findings.summary: Deployments pause while a Severity 1 incident is active.
findings.source_quote: Deployments are paused during an active Severity 1 incident.

findings.title: Rollback evidence
findings.summary: The release owner records the rollback command before requesting production approval.
findings.source_quote: The release owner must record the rollback command before requesting production approval.

findings.title: Noisy alert triage
findings.summary: Check the support queue before paging on-call when alert noise makes customer impact unclear.
findings.source_quote: When the alert is noisy but customer impact is unclear, check the support queue before paging the on-call engineer.

findings.title: Daily reconciliation timing
findings.summary: The export is generated after the upstream ledger closes at 18:00 IST.
findings.source_quote: The daily reconciliation export is generated after 18:30 IST because the upstream ledger closes at 18:00 IST.

questions.question: What caused the 14 March 2026 service interruption?
questions.answer: The postmortem attributes it to connection-pool exhaustion during a downstream timeout spike.

questions.question: What is the default public API rate limit?
questions.answer: 50 requests per second per client key.

questions.question: Who approves a refund above INR 5,00,000?
questions.answer: The Finance Director, according to the refund approval policy.

employee_notes.author: Sarah Chen
employee_notes.title: Telemetry dashboard discrepancy
employee_notes.content: If the deploy dashboard and service dashboard disagree, trust the service dashboard for customer impact until telemetry catches up. Record the discrepancy and revisit it after the next telemetry refresh.

employee_notes.author: Sarah Chen
employee_notes.title: Handover evidence format
employee_notes.content: For a handover, include the exact command and the expected output; a screenshot alone is not enough.
